content.text: You are a Claude Code expert. Question: My coding agent sessions accumulate huge standing context (up to ~400K tokens) mostly from inlined base64 screenshot tool_results (a UI loop reading 36-74 distinct PNGs per session, each 150-590KB). Auto-compact is enabled. What are ALL the mechanisms in Claude Code for reducing/controlling how much of the session history gets re-read on every API call? Specifically: (1) does auto-compact evict old tool_results including images? (2) is there a way to cap how many recent messages stay in context? (3) context editing / /context command? (4) any setting to exclude large tool results? (5) subagent pattern - does a Task subagent's transcript stay out of the caller context? Be concrete and cite setting names.
I'll verify against the installed CLI rather than answer from memory.
